title.narrative: Towards an open, fair and sustainable Europe in the world - Third Trio EU Presidency Project

description.narrative: The overall objective is to contribute to increased public and political support for EU¿s international partnerships in order to reach the 2030 Agenda and rebuild better, greener, and in a more equal, gender transformative, way. The specific objectives are: 1.Public and political awareness of EU¿s role as a global actor in international partnerships has increased; 2.Civil society is better equipped to engage in EU-related advocacy and awareness raising around the EU's role as global actor in international partnerships; and 3.Efforts to contribute to sufficient, effective and coherent international partnerships have been made, in Member States and at the EU level.

title.narrative: Perceived importance of development cooperation has increased % of EU citizens say it is important for the EU to partner with other countries to reduce poverty around the world

description.narrative: Perceived importance of development cooperation has increased % of EU citizens say it is important for the EU to partner with other countries to reduce poverty around the world

comment.narrative: 89 of EU citizens considered it important to partner with countries outside the EU to reduce poverty around the world with 42 of the opinion this is very important in 2022. With this specific question being omitted from the 2023 Barometer the most closely related question indicates that 74 of EU citizens think tackling poverty in developing countries should be one of the main priorities of the EU down from 80 in 2022. This could be an indication that there is a general decrease of importance of reducing poverty development cooperation among the EU citizens from 2023 onwards despite having met the target in 2022.

comment.narrative: In the 2021 Eurobarometer 61 of respondents said that the EU should focus on reducing inequalities in partner countries and not only help improve economic situation. Inequalities is a multidimensional concept including economic social political and climate inequality. While the 2023 Eurobarometer does not include a question on inequalities as a concept respondents clearly indicate that economic growth is ONE of several important focus areas of EU development cooperation. Peace and security 40 health 29 economic growth 28 human rights 26 climate change 25 education 21 and fighting corruption 17 remain important to EU citizens all of which can contribute to reducing inequalities.
